name: Navratan Mixture
ingredients_raw: Refined Cottonseed oil, Bengal gram flour, Peanut (14%), Rice flakes (11%), Split Bengal gram (10%), Lentil (10%), Spices & condiments (Red chilli powder, Cloves powder, Mace powder, Nutmeg powder, Long pepper (Piper longum), Dried ginger powder, Black pepper powder, Mango powder, Coriander, Fennel}, lodized salt, Potato chips (1.8%) & Colour (INS 102 & INS 133)
